description: This file contains the implementation of the 'HTMLPurifier_VarParser_Native' class, which uses PHP's internal eval() function to parse and evaluate expressions for variable parsing within the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_VarParser_Native
classes.description: A class that uses PHP's eval() function to parse and evaluate variable expressions, inheriting from HTMLPurifier_VarParser.

methods.name: parseImplementation
methods.description: Parses a variable based on type and null allowance by evaluating the expression directly using eval.

methods.name: evalExpression
methods.description: Evaluates a PHP expression string and returns the resulting value, throwing an exception if eval fails.
